name: Kimi to Boku to Hitorigoto
original_name: きみとぼくとひとりごと
source:
“Well then, here and now, let's talk about the truth that was never revealed.”

Empty words, secret words and finally, "my own words". Everything about the mysterious boy "Akino" is revealed here.

[Translated from the [url=https://enoshima210.work/hitorigoto/]official website[/url]]
translation:
“那么，就在此时此地，我们来谈谈从未被揭露的真相吧。”

空话，密语，最后是“我自己的话”。关于神秘少年“秋野”的一切都在这里揭晓。

[翻译自[url=https://enoshima210.work/hitorigoto/]官网[/url]]
